theme: Light editorial foundation with deep charcoal/ink typography, warm travertine stone tones, subtle terracotta/burnt ochre accents, and cinematic dark scrim hero layers
archetype: Organic & Earthy meets High-End Editorial Travel Documentary (Archetype 1 + Luxury Editorial)

typography.pairing_strategy: Editorial Future & Documentarian Contrast: Playfair Display / Lora (Serif Display & Headings) + DM Sans / Instrument Sans (Modern Geometric Body) + JetBrains Mono (Technical Systems, Workflows, Timestamps)

typesetting_rules.hero_headline: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-[1.08]
typesetting_rules.section_headline: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-snug
typesetting_rules.eyebrow_label: text-xs font-mono font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-accent

entry_surfaces./: cinematic full-viewport hero with layered parallax travel imagery, kinetic line-by-line reveal, positioning badge, primary showcase CTA, and live status beacon

layout_and_grids.bento_grid_style: Tetris Grid with 12 columns on desktop (col-span-8 dominant visuals, col-span-4 interactive specs, col-span-6 side-by-side workflow comparisons)
layout_and_grids.editorial_rhythm: Asymmetrical section balance, generous top/bottom whitespace (py-24 to py-32), delicate 1px borders in #E5E1D8 / rgba(255,255,255,0.1), numbered manifesto chapters (01–09)

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration with customized wheel damping for documentary feel
motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Masked staggered line-by-line kinetic reveal using Framer Motion (motion/react) variants
motion_and_interactions.journey_path: Scroll-linked SVG path trace connecting Marketing -> Tourism -> Hospitality -> Content -> Operations -> Digital Products -> Travel Systems
motion_and_interactions.system_workflows: Interactive node-by-node animated workflow simulator with live state toggles (e.g. Normal vs Low Margin Warning triggers in CRM simulator)
motion_and_interactions.case_study_drawer: Seamless full-screen / expanded modal reading view for the 3 major systems with 9 structured chapters each
motion_and_interactions.travel_gallery: Smooth horizontal drag/scroll gallery with custom progress bar and location metadata overlays
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion: automatically flattens transforms and replaces positional spring animations with instant opacity fades

image_urls.description: Epic winding mountain pass highway in dramatic lighting (representing the travel journey and systems)
Serene turquoise Ganges river in Rishikesh valley surrounded by mountains and bridges (Rishikesh internship story)
Historic riverside ashrams and mountain landscape in Rishikesh (Hospitality & Content storytelling)
Boutique heritage hotel entrance and architectural character (Moustache Escapes F&B and stays context)
Heritage hotel checkered lobby and curated space (F&B and guest experience touchpoints)
Dramatic atmospheric mountain pass asphalt road under cloud cover (Field explorations & logistics)
Long open highway extending toward alpine peaks (The builder's path)

accessibility_requirements.wcag_level: WCAG AA compliant (4.5:1 text contrast minimum against backgrounds)
accessibility_requirements.data_testids: MANDATORY: all interactive elements, filters, modals, form inputs, buttons, and navigation links must carry clear kebab-case data-testid tags (e.g. data-testid="nav-work-link", data-testid="project-card-triplin", data-testid="case-study-open-triplin", data-testid="crm-warning-toggle", data-testid="contact-submit-button")
accessibility_requirements.keyboard_navigation: Full keyboard focus trap for modal views, Escape to close, visible focus rings with ring-accent
accessibility_requirements.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion media query detection via Framer Motion useReducedMotion

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the cinematic documentary art direction strictly. Avoid generic SaaS blue or standard AI-gradient aesthetics.
Install lenis via yarn if smooth scrolling is enabled, or use native CSS smooth scroll and Framer Motion for scroll-linked animations.

Ensure 'Things I've Built' workflow diagram is truly interactive: users should be able to click through steps (Destination -> Vendors -> B2B Rates -> Package -> Costing -> Marketing -> Enquiry -> Quotation -> Booking), see the active node highlight, and inspect the Margin Engine logic with the 'LOW MARGIN — REVIEW PRICING' alert switch.
CaseStudyModal must support reading all 9 numbered chapters in a comfortable editorial drawer layout with quick sidebar jump links.
Every photo specified in media_and_assets is an authentic Unsplash asset - render them using img tags with object-cover and subtle scale-up hover animations.
Ensure the contact section includes an interactive inquiry form that triggers a toast confirmation via sonner.
